command: QEMU_VIRT='-machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' python3 scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-source-fast --probe-source-module disk:/Demo/MultiCore/MPRadix.ZC --probe-source tests/compat/MultiCore1Runtime.ZC --probe-source-call MultiCore1RuntimeAcceptance
target: AArch64 QEMU virt, PCI graphical terminal, single guest CPU; bundled ARM64 source overlay
verified: The bundled MPRadix source loads and runs QuickSort, QuickSortU32, and the radix stage on a guest reporting one CPU.
All three sort demonstrations print identical sorted sample bytes.
MultiCore1RuntimeAcceptance exercises the one-CPU worker, Spawn, Yield, result aggregation, and completion paths; it returns 0x2a only when all 15 internal checks pass.
The source probe completes and the native compiler resets to ready state.
scope_note: This verifies the single-CPU fallback and cooperative task checks in QEMU only. It does not establish multi-CPU radix distribution, full scheduler equivalence, live UTM behavior, or Pi hardware behavior.
